neighbours.label: the verb after the second of two contrasted subjects, in a parallel structure ('A is X, and B is Y'; 'whereas B refers to')
fire: Django is a web framework written in Python, and Redis is an in-memory database.
Mitosis refers to division in body cells, whereas meiosis refers to division in sex cells.
The left chart is correct for small loads and the right chart is correct for big loads.
Baseball is popular in Japan, and cricket is popular in India.
Red wine is served with beef, while white wine is served with fish.
The first number is the height of the room, and the second number is its width.
Mercury is the closest planet to the Sun, and Neptune is the farthest.
Sodium makes the solution basic, whereas chlorine makes it acidic.
quiet: Django is a web framework written in Python, and it is used by many large sites.
Mitosis refers to division in body cells, and it takes about an hour to finish.
The left chart is correct for small loads and it is printed on page nine.
Baseball is popular in Japan, and it is played at every school.
Red wine is served with beef, and it is best at room temperature.
The first number is the height of the room, and it is written in feet.
Mercury is the closest planet to the Sun, and it is very hot by day.
Sodium makes the solution basic, and it reacts quickly with water.

short: verb of the second parallel subject
notes: Card: ' is' x4, ' will', ' as', ' others', ' part': 'Twisted is ..., and Tor is', 'Portugal, for its part', 'anemia refers'. Probe: 'and Tor is' 0.725; 'and the high plot is valid' 0.456; 'whereas aplastic refers' 0.425; 'for its part' 0.153; same clauses with a pronoun subject: 'and it is' 0.024, 'and it felt' 0.022.
